sentences.text:
Shri Kshitij Vyas, learned Panel Lawyer for the respond
 Order
Heard and perused the record.

2. This is first bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.273/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station Meghnagar, District-Jhabua, for the offence under Sections 376(2) n & 506 of IPC.

The applicant is in custody since 15.10.2024.
3.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant has committed upon the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.

The prosecutrix is a major lady and as per statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., it is revealed that the prosecutrix and applicant was in relationship for long time, but when the applicant denied to marry, prosecutrix lodged an FIR against him on 15.10.2024.
He further submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party.
The applicant is in custody since 15.10.2024.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:32073 2 MCRC-47625-2024 long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
